mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.task_no, t.task_name, t.task_type, t.template_id, tpl.template_name, t.route_id, r.route_name, t.assign_mode, t.vehicle_id, t.vin, t.plate_no, t.loop_flag, t.loop_count, t.schedule_flag, t.start_time, t.actual_start_time, t.finish_time, t.task_status, t.current_loop_no, t.current_point_seq, t.current_action_seq, t.command_json, t.error_message, t.create_time, t.remark from biz_robot_task t left join biz_task_template tpl on tpl.template_id = t.template_id and tpl.del_flag = '0' left join biz_scene_route r on r.route_id = t.route_id and r.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: order by case t.task_status when 'pending' then 1 when 'running' then 2 when 'abnormal' then 3 when 'canceled' then 4 when 'completed' then 5 else 9 end, t.start_time asc, t.create_time desc, t.task_id desc
